jd_template:
{company} is looking for a {role} to join its team in {location}.

In this role you will:
- plan and deliver your own work against agreed deadlines
- work closely with colleagues in other teams
- explain your decisions clearly to people without your background

We are looking for someone who has:
- delivered a piece of work under a tight deadline
- resolved a disagreement with a colleague
- improved a process and measured the result

stories.title: Delivered the quarterly report two days early
stories.body:
**Situation.** The quarterly report was due in five working days, and two of the four people who usually prepared it were away.

**Task.** I was asked to make sure it went out on time.

**Action.** I split the report into sections, took the two largest myself, and set a short check-in each afternoon with the one colleague left. With the agreement of the person I reported to, I moved two routine tasks to the following week.

**Result.** The report went out two days before the deadline, and the review that followed found no errors in it.

stories.title: Settled a disagreement over priorities
stories.body:
**Situation.** A colleague and I disagreed about which of two requests to finish first, and the work had stalled for a week.

**Task.** I wanted us to agree a plan we could both stand behind.

**Action.** I asked for half an hour with them, wrote down what each request would cost and what waiting would cost, and suggested we take the comparison to the person who had asked for both.

**Result.** We agreed an order the same afternoon, and both requests were finished within the month.

stories.title: Cut the time to process a request
stories.body:
**Situation.** Requests took nine days on average to process, and people often chased them.

**Task.** I offered to find out where the time went.

**Action.** I followed twenty requests from start to finish, found that most of the delay was waiting for a second signature, and proposed that requests under a set value need only one.

**Result.** After the change the average fell to four days, measured over the next two months.

untold_stories.title: Kept one hand-off list with the delivery team
untold_stories.body:
**Situation.** A launch needed my team and the delivery team to pass work back and forth, and the two teams kept missing each other's dates.

**Task.** I offered to sort out the hand-offs.

**Action.** I met the delivery team's lead once a week, and we kept one shared list of every hand-off with its date and who owned it.

**Result.** The launch went out on its planned date, and the list was kept for the next one.

untold_stories.title: Covered a colleague's work while they were away
untold_stories.body:
**Situation.** A colleague was away for three weeks at short notice, and two of their pieces of work were due in that time.

**Task.** I agreed to keep both moving until they were back.

**Action.** I read their notes, asked the two people waiting what they needed by when, and set myself a short daily slot for each piece.

**Result.** Both pieces went out on their dates, and I handed back a one-page note of where each one stood.

directives: Prepare for two requirements from the posting: the one your note "Delivered the quarterly report two days early" covers, and the one your story "Kept one hand-off list with the delivery team" fits.

Also prepare for one thing the posting does not list, which you name yourself as "keeping work going while a key colleague is away", and tell your story "Covered a colleague's work while they were away" for it.
